text_block_list.text:
After seizing victory in the Japanese
Derby,
Симболи Рудольф raises two fingers
high: two
crowns. The Classic Triple
Crown is starting to
look like a real
possibility.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She resolves to claim the final crown in
the
Kikuka Sho, but her packed
schedule is starting
to take its toll, and
Эйр Грув is only getting
more
concerned.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As usual, however, it's Симболи Рудольф's
way or
the highway. Even a grueling race
can't keep her
from her student council
duties.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
